name: Gmail Invoice & Receipt Auto-Organizer to Google Drive V3
description: VA automation V3: weekly Friday pull of Gmail invoices/receipts with upgraded PII redaction and a sensitive-attachment gate (holds back tax/bank docs to Slack review instead of uploading). Safe items dedup and save to Drive Accounting/Receipts/YYYY/Vendor

channelId.value: <__PLACEHOLDER_VALUE__Slack channel ID for sensitive-attachment review, e.g. receipts-needs-review__>

parameters.jsCode: const items = $input.all(); const meta = items[0]; const match = items.find(i => (i.json.name || "").toLowerCase() === "invoice and receipt log"); return [{ json: { ...meta.json, logSpreadsheetId: match ? match.json.id : "", logSpreadsheetExists: !!match }, binary: meta.binary || {} }];

parameters.content:
## Redaction + Attachment Gate (V3)

Redaction upgraded: IBAN, phone, non-sender emails added; account/routing only redacted with a banking-context word nearby (invoice/order numbers survive).

NEW: "Attachment Sensitive?" holds back any attachment whose subject/body/filename mention SSN, W-2/W-9, 1099, tax return, bank statement, voided check, wire instructions, etc. Those are flagged to Slack and NOT uploaded to Drive. File them by hand.
